description: Report which backend this server targets ("old" devtools or "builder"), WHY (a USE_OLD_DEVTOOLS env override, the persisted config, or the default), and which mode is persisted for the next start. Change it with set_devtools_mode. Also reports auth status for both login systems: builderAuthenticated and oldDevtoolsAuthenticated. Both are PRESENCE checks, not validity checks — a stale token still reports true; a real call surfaces the staleness with an error naming the tool to re-run. Which login authorizes what: how_it_works({ topic: "auth" }).
name: get_devtools_mode
